oak:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: game-ready PBR material albedo source map, oak
Primary request: square seamless physically based albedo texture of natural quarter-sawn European pale oak, fine elongated pores and subtle broad warm caramel growth grain, clear matte finish. Continuous wood surface, NO plank boundaries or gaps, grain flows vertically. Natural restrained color variation, close enough to expose fine pores; scan-quality neutral albedo.
Composition/framing: exactly square, edge-to-edge full material, orthographic front-on view, no perspective. Seamless tiling: opposite edges must match continuously with no boundary or dark edge. Photoreal material scan quality at high resolution, 2048 pixels square preferred.
